record.paper_title: Unsolved Problems in Visibility Graphs of Points, Segments and Polygons
record.context_brief: Chromatic number of bar k-visibility graphs
record.original_question: Improve the current upper bound 6k + 6 on the chromatic number of a bar k-visibility graph.

evidence.quote: Open Problem 23 Improve the current upper bound of 6k + 6 on the chromatic number of a bar k-visibility graph.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. A bar representation is a finite collection of pairwise disjoint horizontal closed line segments ("bars") in the plane, no two of which lie on the same horizontal line. Given such a representation $B = \{b_1, \dots, b_n\}$, the associated bar $k$-visibility graph $G(B)$ has vertex set $\{b_1, \dots, b_n\}$, with $b_i$ and $b_j$ adjacent if and only if there exists a vertical (open) line segment with endpoints on $b_i$ and $b_j$ that crosses the interiors of at most $k$ other bars of $B$. A graph $G$ is called a bar $k$-visibility graph if $G \cong G(B)$ for some bar representation $B$.

It is known that the chromatic number of every bar $k$-visibility graph is at most $6k + 6$. Determine whether this upper bound can be improved: that is, find the smallest constant $c(k)$ (as a function of $k$) such that every bar $k$-visibility graph admits a proper vertex coloring with at most $c(k)$ colors, and in particular establish an upper bound strictly better than $6k + 6$.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches surface the original work of Dean, Ellis-Monaghan, Hamilton, and Pangborn establishing the $6k+6$ bound and the bound of 12 for $k=1$, and follow-up work improving thickness bounds, but no source explicitly improves the chromatic-number upper bound of $6k+6$ for general $k$. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Bar k-Visibility Graphs (Dean et al.)
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes the upper bound 6k+6 on the chromatic number of bar k-visibility graphs and the bound 12 for k=1.
status_evidence.claim: The 6k+6 bound is the standard known upper bound.

status_evidence.title: Further Results on Bar k-Visibility Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Improves bounds on thickness of bar k-visibility graphs but does not provide a chromatic number improvement beyond 6k+6.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work improves related parameters but not the chromatic upper bound.
